_recon_note: BUNDLED DEFAULT, compiled into the recon binary. This is the pass-2 semi-enzymatic search on the identified subset. It carries NO database.fasta and NO mzml_paths on purpose: pass 2 always writes the generated subset FASTA and the run's own mzML. precursor_tol, fragment_tol, isotope_errors and the mods are ALSO overridden at runtime from what pass 1 measured — the values below are the fallback shape, not a record of what ran. That record is the pass2-effective-params.json written beside the search, and Sage's own results.json beside that. Every other field must match testing/configs/digestion-efficiency-pass2.json — bundled_default_matches_committed_template asserts it.

_recon_pass2_provenance.mods_note: Pass 2 searches with NO fixed and NO variable mods. It measures where trypsin cut, not what is modified, and pass 1 is an OPEN search whose modification set is unknown by design.
_recon_pass2_provenance.sign_note: precursor_tol is INVERTED relative to the delta mass it produces; measured on serum 2026-08-29. See src/pass2.rs.
